evidence.reason: The alleged vulnerable `join(repoRoot, file.path)` write is gone at the pinned tip. Lines 297-301 now resolve the target with `pathResolve(repoRoot, file.path)` and reject absolute paths and any relative result that is empty or escapes (`rel.startsWith('..')` or absolute `rel`) before `mkdir`/`writeFile`, matching the finding's proposed fix (with an added empty-relative guard). The git-add-then-fail ordering the finding relied on can no longer lead to an out-of-checkout write. History shows fix commit 71a6cbc8 "fix(forge-github): Harden ratchet effects..." containing this hardening.
